submitter: vigilant designer + offer/benefit analyser lane — migration 740: info-card-grid's carousel flag defaults ON at resolution time (owner ruling 2026-09-03, 'switch the switches')
rationale:
The owner ruled on 2026-09-03 that info-card-grid's `carousel` flag should be default-on. [MEASURED 2026-09-03 12:41:06Z, live DB] it is set on 1 of 40 live instances (pages filtered `build_status='deployed' AND status='active'`, both arms — the estate's standing landmine about selecting on build_status alone) across 21 sites.

The handoff left the DESIGN question open: does the default live as a schema default plus a backfill of the instances, or at resolution time? This change answers it with the mechanism that already exists rather than a new one. `plan_sections_action.go:2886` — the renderer/static branch — reads `if !carryStored() && fallback != nil { resolvedData[fieldName] = fallback }`. So a `fallback` on a `source: static` field IS a resolution-time default, and a stored value beats it. No backfill is performed and none is needed.

That last clause is load-bearing and I measured it rather than assumed it. `carryStored()` calls `storedFieldValue()`, which rejects a value only when `datahelpers.IsEmptyContentValue` says empty — and a Go `bool` hits that function's DEFAULT arm, so a stored `false` is NOT empty, IS carried, and WOULD beat this fallback. [MEASURED 2026-09-03 12:41:06Z] of the 40 live instances, 1 stores `carousel: true`, ZERO store `false`, and 39 do not carry the key at all. Had the 39 stored an explicit false, this migration would apply cleanly, verify green, and change nothing.

The mechanism is proven live on the SECTION path, not merely read: [MEASURED 2026-09-03] `ai-readiness-quiz` declares 12 `source: static` fields with fallbacks, and both live instances (finetuning.uk, leopardessconsulting.co.uk) carry those fallbacks persisted byte-for-byte into `page_components.content_data` (`quiz_back_label='Back'`, `quiz_badge_label='AI Readiness Assessment'`). Static fields are never offered to the writer, so those values can only have come from this path.

PRE-FLIGHT GATE, measured at the artefact because the field's own guidance names a dependency: the layout 'requires the hero-card-carousel js_snippet to be bundled for the site ... without it ... only the arrows are inert'. Arrows that render and do nothing are worse than the grid. `js_snippets` has ONE matching active row whose `applies_to` is ["hero-card-carousel", "info-card-grid"], so the bundle follows the COMPONENT, not the flag; and [MEASURED 2026-09-03] all 21 carrier sites serve /assets/js/snippets.js at HTTP 200 with 15 `data-hcc` occurrences each. NEGATIVE CONTROL, because a constant 15 could mean the grep matches something always present: 6 sites WITHOUT info-card-grid serve 0, one of them (fundamentallyai.com) with a 10,928-byte bundle — so it is not 'small bundle = zero'. The instrument discriminates.

I am also correcting my own lane's acceptance test in the same breath, because following it would make a CORRECT flip read as a defect. HANDOFF_2026-09-03 §3.2 names `overflow-x` as the NEGATIVE control ('a flip that moves overflow-x is doing something other than what it says'). That is false: the template's ONLY `overflow-x` (line 204) sits INSIDE the `{{if $.carousel}}` style block, so a correct flip ADDS ONE per flipped instance. The equal count of 2 was a coincidence of unrelated CSS on two different pages of two different sites — [MEASURED 2026-09-03 at the served bytes] leopardess/services.html has 1 from another component's `--trp-track-gap` plus 1 from the info-card-grid carousel block itself, while designblog/index.html has 2 from `.category-strip`, emitted twice. The corrected test is in the migration header and is a before/after on the SAME page.

plan.summary: One appliable migration setting `"fallback": true` on info-card-grid's `carousel` field descriptor, plus its rollback. No Go change, no image build. Config is live on apply but no served page moves until it re-renders; the re-render path applies it (rerender_page_sections_action.go:1450 calls the same planSection, and its own comment records that plan.ResolvedData merges LAST and wins over stored content_data).
plan.risks:
BLAST RADIUS IS FLEET-WIDE AND VISIBLE: 39 of 40 live instances across 21 sites change layout on their next render. This is the owner's ruling, stated as such, not a side effect — but it is the largest thing in this submission and the reason the pre-flight gate above was measured at the artefact rather than argued from config.

A stored `carousel: false` would silently beat the fallback and make this inert. Measured today as zero instances; a reviewer should treat that count as stale-by-addition and re-run it.

The fallback must be a JSON boolean. A Go template `{{if}}` is truthy on ANY non-empty string, so a string "false" would render a carousel. The verify block asserts jsonb_typeof = 'boolean' and the assertion is proven to fire (mutation test below).

IDEMPOTENCY, stated because this lane shipped the opposite defect two days ago: migration 723 used `replace()` on text that re-embedded its own anchor, so a second run stacks a second copy. 740 is a `jsonb_set` to a fixed value and cannot do that — running it twice leaves the same single key. The drift guard additionally aborts if the fallback is already present.

The change is inert if the template stops gating on the flag, and inert config verifies green — so the drift guard asserts `position('{{if $.carousel}}' in html_template) <> 0` before writing.

edits.rationale: Sets the resolution-time default. Carried here IN FULL — guards, UPDATE and the entire verify block — because this lane's last submission (723) showed only part of a verify block in its sketch and drew a gating HIGH objection saying the verify lacked assertions that were in fact present. The submission is the artefact under review, not the file.

Removes the fallback key with `#-`, guarded both ways. Note what it does NOT do: it does not touch stored page data, so an instance whose content_data has since stored `carousel: true` keeps it (carryStored beats an absent fallback), and already-rendered carousels stay carousels until their next render. Stated rather than silently true.
